title: How to install cursor in Cursor on Mac: a complete guide for developers
metaTitle: How to install Cursor on Mac: Step by Step Guide
description: Learn how to install Cursor on Mac with this simple guide. Follow these steps to set up the AI-powered code editor on your macOS system today.
intro: You can install Cursor on Mac by downloading the installer from the official Cursor website and moving the application to your folder. The process takes only a few minutes and integrates directly into your macOS environment.
tldr: Download the DMG file from cursor.com.
Drag the Cursor icon to your Applications folder.
Open the app and sign in to sync your settings.
Import your existing VS Code extensions to get started.

blocks.text: Why choose Cursor for your development workflow

Cursor is a fork of VS Code, meaning it feels familiar to anyone who has used that editor. It adds AI agents directly into the interface. These agents help with code generation, multi-file edits, and debugging. By using the same extension ecosystem as VS Code, it keeps your existing tools working.

Before you install Cursor on Mac, ensure you are running a recent version of macOS. It supports both Apple Silicon and Intel chips. You do not need to uninstall VS Code. Cursor runs as a separate application, allowing you to test it without breaking your current setup.
Follow these steps to get the editor running on your machine.

items: Go to the official Cursor website.
Click the download button for macOS.
Wait for the DMG file to finish downloading.
Double-click the file to mount the disk image.
Drag the Cursor icon into the Applications folder shortcut.
Eject the disk image from your desktop.

blocks.text: When you open Cursor for the first time, macOS might show a security warning. This is common for downloaded apps. You can override this in System Settings if needed. Once open, sign in with your GitHub or Google account. The app will ask if you want to import your VS Code settings and extensions. This is the fastest way to maintain your workflow.

Some users report a damaged app error. This usually happens if the download was interrupted. Try deleting the app and re-downloading it from the official site. If you see performance issues, check your extensions. Some older VS Code plugins might conflict with the AI features.

faq.question: Is Cursor free to use?
faq.answer: Cursor offers a free tier for individuals. You can check their pricing page for details on pro plans and usage limits.

faq.question: Does it replace VS Code?
faq.answer: It is a separate app, but it can import your VS Code settings. You can use both side by side.
